title: Fallowbrook 种间流动交易设计
instruction:
您是 Viktor Hartnett，是为俄亥俄州 Fallowbrook Industries 制造业务提供支持的运输和库存职员。从 3 月份开始，涂漆组件将通过距离主工厂 40 英里的租用精加工单元进行运输，Priya Nightingale 在确定 ERP 工作范围之前需要可靠的厂间材料和交易设计。目前的 ERP 许可证覆盖一个地点，客户要求通过喷漆进行不间断的批次追踪，每个卡车循环都有有意义的成本，并且精加工单元有一个没有暂存空间的码头。将部分完成的`Fallowbrook_interplant_design_template.xlsx`与`Saltcombe_flow_requirements_2025-01-15.pdf`中的运营、ERP、质量和俄亥俄州要求一起使用。完成一个可重复使用的分析模型，比较当前和发布阶段，评估源材料中确定的所有三种替代方案，根据规定的政策推荐一种设计，并记录为什么另外两种被搁置。该模型必须显示每次交接时的物理移动、ERP 交易、保管和记录、批次跟踪控制以及对不匹配或不合格批次的响应。将用户可编辑的假设与计算结果明确分开，保留模板的字段名称和约定，并包含简短的指导，以便其他职员可以更新模型而不会模糊决策本身。
Priya 还需要一份语言通俗易懂的决策简介，适合不从事运输或 ERP 工作的读者；将 PDF 保持不超过三页，并在不打开工作簿的情况下使重要的期间变更、建议、替代方案、成本、约束和控制易于理解。应用截至 15 1 月 2025 数据包中提供的 ISO 9001 和俄亥俄州要求，并确定在业务和 ERP 以不同方式使用“站点”一词时您必须做出的任何解释。使用`Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx`和`Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf`将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层；两个文件共享的建议和每个数字必须一致。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/Fallowbrook_interplant_design_template.xlsx` — 部分完成的分析模型模板，包含所需的工作表名称、字段标签、选项和标准词汇、输入/输出约定、验证选择和决策关键结构。
- `references/Saltcombe_flow_requirements_2025-01-15.pdf` — 两个比较期的受控源、操作假设、三种允许的设计、ERP 行为、交易代码、决策政策、成本、批次跟踪要求、ISO 9001 控制以及截至15 1 月2025 的适用俄亥俄州要求。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx` — 完整的、可重用的厂间流程和交易模型，具有可编辑的假设、实时计算、选项评分、交易控制和内部一致的决策关键。 （保留模板所需的字段和工作表约定；区分可编辑输入和计算输出；在需要计算的地方使用实时公式；不包含外部链接或宏；并在标准电子表格应用程序中保持可操作性。）
- `Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf` — 简明语言的决策简报，总结了期间比较、建议的套间设计、替代方案、交易流程、成本、质量控制和管理要求。 （不超过三页；适合广大非专业受众；并与已完成的练习册完全一致。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Saltcombe Flow Requirements | controlled issue 2025-01-15
Fallowbrook Industries — Ohio fabrication plant and leased remote paint cell

Purpose
This controlled snapshot defines the March launch decision. “Current state” is 06 January–28 February 2025: 1,200 paint-bound assemblies per
week. “Launch state” begins 03 March 2025: 2,400 paint-bound assemblies per week. Each customer lot remains the customer lot through paint;
a rack, container or paint-batch identifier may be added only as a linked identifier.

Operating and transport basis
     Input                           Controlled value

     Plant to leased cell            40 one-way miles; use 80 round-trip miles per truck loop

     Usable vehicle capacity         240 assemblies per completed loop

     Cost basis                      $1.20/mile × round-trip miles + $160 driver + $44 handling per loop

     Dock condition                  One dock, no staging. Appointment-controlled direct handoff only. If the cell cannot accept, keep the load at the plant or resc

     Material change                 Flag demand and cost at ≥20% absolute percentage change; flag loops at ≥2 loops/week.

ERP interpretation and permissible designs
The current licence supports one ERP site. A genuine second ERP site requires an additional licence and implementation readiness; neither is
available by 03 March 2025. The business word “site” means physical operating location; ERP “site” means licensed configuration object. The
three, and only three, alternatives are: (1) Remote warehouse within current ERP site; (2) Licensed second ERP site; (3) Outside-processing
purchase order.

Decision policy
Mandatory gates: (a) unbroken customer-lot traceability; (b) appointment/direct-handoff operation compatible with one dock and no staging; and
(c) ERP capability ready at launch. An alternative failing any gate is INELIGIBLE regardless of score. Score eligible alternatives on a 1–5 scale:
Transport cost 25%; Customer-lot traceability 30%; ERP launch readiness 20%; One-dock operating control 15%; Custody & records 10%. Total
weight must equal 100%. Highest eligible total wins. On an equal total, select higher traceability rating; if still tied, higher transport-cost rating.

Deterministic ratings
Remote warehouse: 5,5,5,4,4 respectively. Licensed second ERP site: 3,5,1,4,4 (ERP readiness gate fails). Outside-processing purchase order:
2,4,4,3,3. Rationale rules: 5 = direct current-capability control; 4 = controlled with an added handoff; 3 = workable but added setup/handoff; 2 =
least favourable cost or external control burden; 1 = unavailable by launch. The listed ratings are the controlled application of these rules to the
stated facts.
 Transaction and record-control process
     Event / code            Required purpose and evidence

     IT-OUT                  Release approved lot, dispatch to carrier and retain pick/release list, signed bill of lading and IT-OUT log. Main plant clerk owns inve

     PC-RECV                 Paint-cell arrival count/condition/lot check; retain PC-RECV check and arrival time. Paint-cell lead takes custody and record control.

     PC-ISSUE                Issue accepted exact customer lot to paint. Retain paint-batch record and completion/inspection record; batch remains linked, never

     IT-RETURN               Scheduled return pickup; retain IT-RETURN log and signed return bill of lading. Carrier custody after handoff.

     FG-RECEIPT              Main plant count, lot/document match and final finished-goods receipt only after quality release; retain receipt, inspection and return

     QHOLD                   For lot/count/document mismatch or nonconforming output: identify and segregate, block issue/consumption/final receipt, retain disc

Quality and Ohio application
Apply ISO 9001:2015 clause 7.5 to controlled, retained dispatch/receipt/quality records; 8.5.2 to identification and end-to-end traceability; 8.5.4 to
preservation in transport and at the cell; and 8.7 to identification, control and authorized disposition of nonconforming output. As of 15 January
2025, Ohio commercial-vehicle/load-securement and carrier-record requirements apply while the carrier transports a load on the route. They do
not create an ERP licence requirement and do not regulate the stationary paint process merely because it is in Ohio. This packet is a task
snapshot, not later legal or certification advice.

Required implementation consequence
The selected design must schedule each direct handoff before release, use the listed local codes only for their stated purpose, carry the same
customer lot on every ordinary event, and route any mismatch or nonconformance to QHOLD pending Quality manager disposition.

gold.text:
Fallowbrook decision brief
Ohio fabrication plant → leased paint cell | Requirements snapshot: 15 January 2025

Decision: use the remote warehouse within the current ERP site for the March launch.
This keeps the leased paint cell as a physical remote location while inventory stays in Fallowbrook’s existing licensed ERP site. It is
the highest eligible design (4.75) and avoids waiting for a second ERP licence. The result is a controlled direct-delivery loop, rather
than a new ERP implementation.

What changes at launch
    Weekly measure               Current                    Launch                   Change / flag
    Paint-bound demand           1,200 assemblies           2,400 assemblies         +1,200 / +100.0% — MATERIAL
    Truck loops                  5                          10                       +5 / +100.0% — MATERIAL
    Transport cost               $1,500                     $3,000                   +$1,500 / +100.0% — MATERIAL

Each loop is an 80-mile round trip. Cost is 80 miles × $1.20, plus $160 driver and $44 handling: $300 per loop. Whole loads are
used: demand ÷ 240-assembly usable capacity, rounded up.

Alternatives considered
    Design                                 Result                      Why
    Remote warehouse within current ERP site
                                         ELIGIBLE • rank 1 • 4.75      Uses current licence, direct lot controls and appointed handoffs.
    Licensed second ERP site               INELIGIBLE • 3.45           A true second ERP site needs added licence and implementation readiness; neithe
    Outside-processing purchase order      ELIGIBLE • rank 2 • 3.25    Workable, but more external handoffs lower traceability, dock-control and custody/r


How the material and records flow
1. Release and dispatch (IT-OUT). The main-plant clerk releases an approved customer lot, labels it with the same lot ID and
obtains carrier custody on a signed bill of lading. 2. Receive and paint (PC-RECV, PC-ISSUE). The paint-cell lead checks lot,
quantity and documents, then issues the same lot to paint. A paint-batch or rack ID is only linked to—not substituted for—the
customer lot. 3. Return and receive (IT-RETURN, FG-RECEIPT). A scheduled carrier pickup returns the lot; the main plant
receives it only after matching lot, quantity, documents and quality release.

Single-dock and quality controls
The paint cell has one dock and no staging. Every delivery and pickup needs an appointment and direct handoff. If the cell cannot
accept a load, the carrier stays at the plant or the trip is rescheduled; it must not queue at the cell. A mismatch in lot, count or
documents—or a nonconforming painted lot—uses QHOLD: material is identified and segregated, cannot be issued, consumed or
finally received, and the Quality manager alone approves release or disposition. Retained evidence includes the hold,
discrepancy/nonconformance record and disposition.

Requirements that shape the design
ISO 9001:2015 requires controlled records (7.5), identification and traceability (8.5.2), preservation (8.5.4), and control of
nonconforming output (8.7). Ohio commercial-vehicle, load-securement and carrier-record rules apply during transport; they do not
create an ERP licence and do not apply to stationary paint processing merely because it is in Ohio. “Site” in everyday business
means a physical location; in ERP it means a licensed configuration object—so the leased cell is remote physically but not a
second ERP site in this launch design.

criteria.description: `Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx` 是有效的、可打开的 XLSX 工作簿，而不是重命名或损坏的文件。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿包结构和成功的工作簿加载。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用支持 OOXML 的库打开并确认所有工作簿部分均已解析且没有修复错误。

original.criterion: `Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx` is a valid, openable XLSX workbook rather than a renamed or corrupted file.
original.evidence: Workbook package structure and successful workbook load.
original.grader_hint: Open with an OOXML-aware library and confirm all workbook parts parse without repair errors.

criteria.description: `Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf` 是一个有效的、可打开的 PDF，具有可提取的页面内容。
criteria.evidence: PDF 标题、页面树和可提取文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 解析 PDF 并确认每个页面都可以读取，没有加密密码或结构错误。

original.criterion: `Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf` is a valid, openable PDF with extractable page content.
original.evidence: PDF header, page tree, and extractable text.
original.grader_hint: Parse the PDF and confirm that every page can be read without an encryption password or structural error.

criteria.description: 该工作簿不包含 VBA 项目，也不包含外部工作簿链接。
criteria.evidence: OOXML 关系、externalLinks 集合和 VBA 包部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查包中的 vbaProject 内容和外部链接关系；普通的内部公式和内部表的超链接是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The workbook contains no VBA project and no external workbook links.
original.evidence: OOXML relationships, externalLinks collection, and VBA package parts.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the package for vbaProject content and external-link relationships; ordinary internal formulas and hyperlinks to internal sheets are acceptable.

criteria.description: 工作簿以相同的顺序保留模板所需的工作表：`Read Me`、`Inputs`、`Option Assessment`、`Flow & Controls` 和 `Decision Key`。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表名称序列。
criteria.grader_hint: 阅读工作簿工作表列表并将其与模板序列进行精确比较。

original.criterion: The workbook retains the template’s required sheets in the same order: `Read Me`, `Inputs`, `Option Assessment`, `Flow & Controls`, and `Decision Key`.
original.evidence: Workbook sheet-name sequence.
original.grader_hint: Read the workbook sheet list and compare it exactly with the template sequence.

criteria.description: 该模型的主要输入、期权评估和交易流范围仍然是结构化的 Excel 表格，具有可用的标题和表格引用。
criteria.evidence: 工作表表格定义和公式参考。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认相应的模板表仍然存在，覆盖完整的记录，并具有唯一的非空标题。

original.criterion: The model’s principal input, option-assessment, and transaction-flow ranges remain structured Excel tables with usable headers and table references.
original.evidence: Worksheet table definitions and formula references.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the corresponding template tables still exist, cover the completed records, and have unique nonblank headers.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包括一个可见的图例，用于区分用户可编辑的输入和计算的或受保护的输出。
criteria.evidence: 图例文本及其显示样式。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到图例并确认它以后续职员可以应用的方式识别两个类别。

original.criterion: The workbook includes a visible legend that distinguishes user-editable inputs from calculated or protected outputs.
original.evidence: Legend text and its displayed styles.
original.grader_hint: Locate the legend and confirm it identifies both classes in terms a subsequent clerk can apply.

criteria.description: 模板指定为用户输入的所有单元格都一致地使用输入视觉约定。
criteria.evidence: 指定输入单元格的单元格样式或填充。
criteria.grader_hint: 将可编辑单元格与模板图例进行比较，并识别任何视觉上看起来像是计算结果的输入。

original.criterion: All cells designated by the template as user inputs use the input visual convention consistently.
original.evidence: Cell styles or fills across designated input cells.
original.grader_hint: Compare the editable cells with the template legend and identify any input that visually appears to be a computed result.

criteria.description: 计算结果单元格使用计算输出约定，并且不会直观地呈现为用户输入。
criteria.evidence: 样式和公式存在于指定的结果单元格中。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查输入、选项评估和决策键的计算范围以获得一致的输出样式。

original.criterion: Calculated result cells use the computed-output convention and are not visually presented as user inputs.
original.evidence: Styles and formula presence in designated result cells.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the calculated ranges on Inputs, Option Assessment, and Decision Key for consistent output styling.

criteria.description: 指定的用户输入单元格被解锁，而公式和决策关键单元格被锁定在启用的工作表保护下。
criteria.evidence: 单元格保护标志和工作表保护设置。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查保护元数据而不是仅依赖颜色；用户必须能够编辑假设而不覆盖公式。

original.criterion: Designated user-input cells are unlocked, while formula and decision-key cells are locked under enabled worksheet protection.
original.evidence: Cell protection flags and worksheet protection settings.
original.grader_hint: Inspect protection metadata rather than relying only on color; users must be able to edit assumptions without overwriting formulas.

criteria.description: `Read Me` 指南简短、可操作，足以让另一名运输职员更新输入、重新计算、解释警告并发布简报，而无需培训。
criteria.evidence: 工作手册中提供的说明和指导。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断一个称职的新职员是否可以在不询问要编辑哪些单元格或如何解释建议的情况下操作该模型；不要奖励冗长的方法手册，因为它会排挤模型。

original.criterion: The `Read Me` guidance is brief, operational, and sufficient for another shipping clerk to update inputs, recalculate, interpret warnings, and publish the brief without training.
original.evidence: Instructions and guidance presented in the workbook.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a competent new clerk could operate the model without asking which cells to edit or how to interpret the recommendation; do not reward a long methods manual that crowds out the model.

criteria.description: 该模型包含模板的替代名称的数据验证列表，候选名称与提供的三个替代名称完全匹配。
criteria.evidence: 数据验证定义和源列表值。
criteria.grader_hint: 解析验证公式或范围，并将候选字符串与模板和需求包进行比较。

original.criterion: The model contains the template’s data-validation list for alternative names, with candidates matching the three supplied alternatives exactly.
original.evidence: Data-validation definitions and source list values.
original.grader_hint: Resolve validation formulas or ranges and compare the candidate strings with the template and requirements packet.

criteria.description: 使用模板的可行性状态约定的字段的验证仅限于提供的状态词汇。
criteria.evidence: 可行性状态单元格的验证定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认验证源仅包含模板中提供的本地状态并适用于每个相关的输入单元格。

original.criterion: Fields using the template’s feasibility status convention have validation restricted to the supplied status vocabulary.
original.evidence: Validation definitions for feasibility-status cells.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the validation source contains only the local statuses supplied in the template and applies to every relevant entry cell.

criteria.description: 使用模板的移动方向和控件所有者约定的字段保留其提供的验证列表。
criteria.evidence: `Flow & Controls` 上的验证对象和覆盖范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 将两个列表及其覆盖范围与提供的模板进行比较；自由文本替换不满足该项目。

original.criterion: Fields using the template’s movement-direction and control-owner conventions retain their supplied validation lists.
original.evidence: Validation objects and covered ranges on `Flow & Controls`.
original.grader_hint: Compare both lists and their coverage with the supplied template; free-text substitutions do not satisfy the item.

criteria.description: 模板的关键运营假设、期间输出和决策结果的命名范围仍然存在，并指向正确的已完成单元格。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿定义的名称和目的地。
criteria.grader_hint: 解析每个所需的模板名称并验证它指向预期值而不是已删除、空白或移位的单元格。

original.criterion: The template’s named ranges for key operating assumptions, period outputs, and decision results still exist and point to the correct completed cells.
original.evidence: Workbook defined names and destinations.
original.grader_hint: Resolve each required template name and verify it points to the intended value rather than a deleted, blank, or displaced cell.

criteria.description: 工作簿在已完成的方案输出中不显示电子表格公式错误。
criteria.evidence: 公式单元格和缓存值（如果可用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式结果中是否存在错误值，例如 `#REF!`、`#DIV/0!`、`#VALUE!`、`#N/A` 或损坏的结构化引用。

original.criterion: The workbook displays no spreadsheet formula errors in the completed scenario outputs.
original.evidence: Formula cells and cached values where available.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formula results for error values such as `#REF!`, `#DIV/0!`, `#VALUE!`, `#N/A`, or broken structured references.

criteria.description: 这两个建模周期对应于需求包中定义的当前状态周期和启动状态周期。
criteria.evidence: 已完成模型中的期间标签和日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 将工作簿期间标识与 PDF 源中的受控期间定义进行比较。

original.criterion: The two modeled periods correspond to the current-state and launch-state periods defined in the requirements packet.
original.evidence: Period labels and dates in the completed model.
original.grader_hint: Compare the workbook period identities with the controlled period definitions in the PDF source.

criteria.description: 每个比较周期的每个源指定操作输入在模型中表示一次，并等于相应的提供值和单位。
criteria.evidence: 已完成的输入表、单位和源数据包。
criteria.grader_hint: 遍历数据包的受控操作输入列表并将其与模型协调一致，检查单位和值。

original.criterion: Every source-designated operating input for each comparison period is represented once in the model and equals the corresponding supplied value and unit.
original.evidence: Completed input table, units, and source packet.
original.grader_hint: Walk the packet’s controlled operating-input list and reconcile it to the model, checking units as well as values.

criteria.description: 公式中使用的距离、车辆容量和运输成本假设等于需求包中的受控假设。
criteria.evidence: 输入单元格、命名范围、公式和源值。
criteria.grader_hint: 将假设跟踪到周期计算中，而不是接受未使用的匹配显示文本。

original.criterion: The distance, vehicle capacity, and transport-cost assumptions used by formulas equal the controlled assumptions in the requirements packet.
original.evidence: Input cells, named ranges, formulas, and source values.
original.grader_hint: Trace the assumptions into the period calculations rather than accepting matching display text that is not used.

criteria.description: 该模型将单坞站和无分段约束捕获为主动设计约束，而不是可选注释。
criteria.evidence: 约束字段、可行性逻辑和流程控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认这些约束会影响选项评估或所需的流程控制，而不仅仅是在叙述中重复。

original.criterion: The model captures the single-dock and no-staging constraints as active design constraints rather than optional notes.
original.evidence: Constraint fields, feasibility logic, and flow controls.
original.grader_hint: Confirm these constraints affect the option assessment or required flow controls and are not merely repeated in narrative.

criteria.description: 客户不间断的批次追踪要求在选项评估中被表示为强制门。
criteria.evidence: 可行性公式和可追溯性标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 未能满足所提供的强制性可追溯性条件的选项不得仅仅因为加权分数高而保持合格。

original.criterion: The customer’s unbroken lot-trace requirement is represented as a mandatory gate in the option assessment.
original.evidence: Feasibility formulas and traceability criterion.
original.grader_hint: An option that fails the supplied mandatory traceability condition must not remain eligible solely because of a high weighted score.

criteria.description: 当前的单站点 ERP 许可证限制使用数据包中规定的适用性和时间来表示。
criteria.evidence: ERP 假设、选项可行性逻辑和决策理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 当数据包描述计时或许可条件时，检查该限制既没有被忽略，也没有被错误地视为永久禁止。

original.criterion: The current single-site ERP licence limitation is represented using the applicability and timing stated in the packet.
original.evidence: ERP assumption, option feasibility logic, and decision rationale.
original.grader_hint: Check that the limitation is neither ignored nor incorrectly treated as a permanent prohibition when the packet describes timing or licensing conditions.

criteria.description: 需求包中的所有三个且仅三个允许的设计都作为决策替代方案出现。
criteria.evidence: `Option Assessment` 中的替代记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 按实质性设计和提供的名称匹配替代方案；仅当映射明确时才可接受修饰缩写。

original.criterion: All three and only the three permissible designs from the requirements packet appear as decision alternatives.
original.evidence: Alternative records in `Option Assessment`.
original.grader_hint: Match alternatives by substantive design and supplied name; cosmetic abbreviation is acceptable only where the mapping is unambiguous.

criteria.description: 决策标准及其权重与数据包中的受控策略相匹配。
criteria.evidence: 标准表和源策略。
criteria.grader_hint: 协调每个标准和权重；任何未提供的标准都不会影响分数。

original.criterion: The decision criteria and their weights match the controlled policy in the packet.
original.evidence: Criteria table and source policy.
original.grader_hint: Reconcile every criterion and weight; no unsupplied criterion may influence the score.

criteria.description: 显示的总标准权重是对标准权重范围求和的公式，而不是粘贴的常数。
criteria.evidence: 细胞总重量公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查配方标记并确认其引用了完整的重量范围。

original.criterion: The displayed total criterion weight is a formula summing the criteria-weight range rather than a pasted constant.
original.evidence: Weight-total cell formula.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the formula token and confirm it references the complete weight range.

criteria.description: 总决策权重等于100%±0.01百分点以内。
criteria.evidence: 计算出的总重量。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据显示的标准权重重新计算，并使用规定的公差与公式结果进行比较。

original.criterion: The total decision weight equals 100% within ±0.01 percentage point.
original.evidence: Calculated weight total.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the displayed criterion weights and compare with the formula result using the stated tolerance.

criteria.description: 每个备选方案的标准评级遵循需求包中的确定性评级规则。
criteria.evidence: 选项评级、来源事实和提供的评级规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据受控事实和阈值重新执行每个评级；如果组件评级不匹配，则不要奖励恰好匹配的总数。

original.criterion: Each alternative’s criterion rating follows the deterministic rating rules in the requirements packet.
original.evidence: Option ratings, source facts, and supplied rating rules.
original.grader_hint: Reperform each rating from the controlled facts and thresholds; do not award for a total that happens to match if component ratings do not.

criteria.description: 每个加权标准结果都是通过参考替代方案评级和相应标准权重的公式计算的。
criteria.evidence: 加权分数单元格公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查评估矩阵中的公式并拒绝引用不相关行的粘贴值或公式。

original.criterion: Every weighted criterion result is calculated by a formula referencing that alternative’s rating and the corresponding criterion weight.
original.evidence: Weighted-score cell formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas across the assessment matrix and reject pasted values or formulas referencing unrelated rows.

criteria.description: 每个备选方案的总分都是一个实时公式，对其完整的加权标准结果集进行求和。
criteria.evidence: 替代总分公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认所有标准结果均包含一次，并且总计中未嵌入硬编码分数。

original.criterion: Each alternative’s total score is a live formula summing its complete set of weighted criterion results.
original.evidence: Alternative total-score formulas.
original.grader_hint: Confirm all criterion results are included once and no hard-coded score is embedded in the total.

criteria.description: 每个替代方案的可行性结果正确地应用了受控决策策略中的每个强制门。
criteria.evidence: 门输入、可行性公式和政策。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立于数据包重新执行门评估并与工作簿进行比较。

original.criterion: The feasibility result for each alternative correctly applies every mandatory gate in the controlled decision policy.
original.evidence: Gate inputs, feasibility formulas, and policy.
original.grader_hint: Reperform the gate evaluation independently from the packet and compare with the workbook.

criteria.description: 替代排名由公式生成，可防止不可行的替代方案在推荐方面超过合格的替代方案。
criteria.evidence: 排名公式和可行性处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式逻辑，包括对不可行行的处理，而不是仅仅依赖显示的排名数字。

original.criterion: Alternative ranking is produced by formulas and prevents an infeasible alternative from outranking an eligible alternative for recommendation purposes.
original.evidence: Rank formulas and treatment of feasibility.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formula logic, including the treatment of infeasible rows, rather than relying on displayed rank numbers alone.

criteria.description: 当符合条件的替代方案具有相同的政策分数时，该模型将实施所提供的平局规则。
criteria.evidence: 推荐或排名公式和政策规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪用于等分的公式分支并确认其标准顺序与数据包匹配。

original.criterion: The model implements the supplied tie-break rule when eligible alternatives have equal policy scores.
original.evidence: Recommendation or ranking formula and policy rule.
original.grader_hint: Trace the formula branch used for equal scores and confirm its criterion order matches the packet.

criteria.description: `Decision Key` 中显示的推荐设计是根据资格、得分和抢七结果生成的，而不是作为常数输入。
criteria.evidence: 推荐单元公式和先例。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查推荐单元并追踪其对评估输出的引用。

original.criterion: The recommended design shown in `Decision Key` is generated from eligibility, score, and tie-break results rather than typed as a constant.
original.evidence: Recommendation-cell formula and precedents.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the recommendation cell and trace its references to the assessment outputs.

criteria.description: 由此产生的建议是受控决策策略选择的合格替代方案。
criteria.evidence: 完成评估、建议和来源政策。
criteria.grader_hint: 从提供的来源重新执行资格、加权评分和平局决胜，并比较所选选项。

original.criterion: The resulting recommendation is the eligible alternative selected by the controlled decision policy.
original.evidence: Completed assessment, recommendation, and source policy.
original.grader_hint: Reperform eligibility, weighted scoring, and tie-breaking from the supplied sources and compare the selected option.

criteria.description: 无需编辑任何公式即可更改模型的可重用假设，并且依赖期间、成本、分数和推荐单元格引用这些假设单元格。
criteria.evidence: 输入单元格、命名范围、公式依赖项和保护元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过相关公式追踪至少一项数量、一项运输成本和一项政策输入。

original.criterion: The model’s reusable assumptions can be changed without editing any formula, and dependent period, cost, score, and recommendation cells reference those assumption cells.
original.evidence: Input cells, named ranges, formula dependencies, and protection metadata.
original.grader_hint: Trace at least one volume, one transport-cost, and one policy input through the dependent formulas.

criteria.description: 每个时期所需的卡车循环是通过一个公式计算的，该公式使用所提供的容量基础将需求四舍五入到整车负载。
criteria.evidence: 卡车环路公式和先例。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查天花板式逻辑并确认部分负载不会产生分数循环。

original.criterion: Required truck loops for each period are calculated with a formula that rounds demand up to whole vehicle loads using the supplied capacity basis.
original.evidence: Truck-loop formulas and precedents.
original.grader_hint: Inspect for ceiling-style logic and confirm partial loads cannot produce fractional loops.

criteria.description: 计算得出的卡车环路计数等于源定义的需求除以每个期间的可用车辆容量（向上舍入）。
criteria.evidence: 周期输入和计算的循环输出。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立地重新计算每个周期；因为结果是整数，所以需要精确一致。

original.criterion: Calculated truck-loop counts equal the source-defined demand divided by usable vehicle capacity, rounded upward, for each period.
original.evidence: Period inputs and calculated loop outputs.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each period independently; exact agreement is required because the result is an integer.

criteria.description: 每个期间的运输成本是使用提供的循环成本组件和计算的循环数的实时公式。
criteria.evidence: 运输成本公式和先例。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证公式是否使用数据包定义的所有且仅成本组成部分，并且不嵌入未解释的常量。

original.criterion: Transport cost for each period is a live formula using the supplied loop-cost components and calculated number of loops.
original.evidence: Transport-cost formulas and precedents.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the formula uses all and only the cost components defined by the packet and does not embed unexplained constants.

criteria.description: 每个期间显示的运输成本与在 ±$1 范围内提供的输入的独立计算结果一致。
criteria.evidence: 期间运输成本和受控假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源值和计算的整个循环重新计算成本，然后应用规定的容差。

original.criterion: Each period’s displayed transport cost agrees with an independent calculation from the supplied inputs within ±$1.
original.evidence: Period transport costs and controlled assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the costs from source values and calculated whole loops, then apply the stated tolerance.

criteria.description: 当前周期和启动周期之间的绝对变化和百分比变化是通过引用两个周期输出的公式来计算的。
criteria.evidence: 期间比较的方差公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式的差异和百分比变化，并确认分母遵循模板约定。

original.criterion: Absolute and percentage changes between current and launch periods are calculated by formulas referencing the two period outputs.
original.evidence: Variance formulas for the period comparison.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas for both difference and percentage change and confirm the denominator follows the template convention.

criteria.description: 材料更改标志正确应用需求包中提供的定量阈值。
criteria.evidence: 更改值、阈值输入和标记公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 对为重要性指定的每个指标重新执行阈值测试，并比较结果标志。

original.criterion: Material-change flags correctly apply the quantitative thresholds supplied in the requirements packet.
original.evidence: Change values, threshold inputs, and flag formulas.
original.grader_hint: Reperform the threshold test for every metric designated for materiality and compare the resulting flags.

criteria.description: 事务设计包括受控流程中每个必需的出站、油漆单元、退货、收货和异常事件。
criteria.evidence: 完成`Flow & Controls`交易表。
criteria.grader_hint: 遍历从发布到最终接收和隔离的源流程，检查是否遗漏或重复了所需的事件。

original.criterion: The transaction design includes every required outbound, paint-cell, return, receipt, and exception event from the controlled process.
original.evidence: Completed `Flow & Controls` transaction table.
original.grader_hint: Walk the source process from release through final receipt and quarantine, checking that no required event is omitted or duplicated.

criteria.description: 分配给流事件的事务代码与数据包中提供的本地代码相匹配，并用于其定义的目的。
criteria.evidence: 事务代码列和源代码定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个代码-事件配对与受控代码列表进行比较；附加到错误事件的正确代码不满足该项目。

original.criterion: Transaction codes assigned to flow events match the local codes supplied in the packet and are used for their defined purposes.
original.evidence: Transaction-code column and source code definitions.
original.grader_hint: Compare each code-event pairing with the controlled code list; a correct code attached to the wrong event does not satisfy the item.

criteria.description: 该流程通过发送、喷漆、退货和最终收货保留相同的客户批次标识，并且不会出现不受支持的批次重新编号。
criteria.evidence: 批次控制字段、交易图和决策理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 端到端跟踪建模的批次标识符，并验证任何辅助容器或批次标识符是否仍链接到客户批次。

original.criterion: The flow preserves the same customer lot identity through dispatch, painting, return, and final receipt, with no unsupported lot renumbering.
original.evidence: Lot-control fields, transaction map, and decision rationale.
original.grader_hint: Trace the modeled lot identifier end to end and verify any subsidiary container or batch identifier remains linked to the customer lot.

criteria.description: 每次移交时的保管和库存记录责任都分配给数据包指定的角色或各方。
criteria.evidence: 交易映射中的托管和控制所有者字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每一次物理交接，包括运营商占有和租赁单元，以确保保管和记录所有权。

original.criterion: Custody and inventory-record responsibility at every handoff are assigned to the roles or parties specified by the packet.
original.evidence: Custody and control-owner fields in the transaction map.
original.grader_hint: Check every physical handoff, including carrier possession and the leased cell, for both custody and record ownership.

criteria.description: 每个流事件标识数据包中定义的所需源记录或证据。
criteria.evidence: 必需的记录列和来源要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 使事件到记录的映射与受控记录列表保持一致，包括发送、接收、油漆完成和返回的证明。

original.criterion: Each flow event identifies the required source record or evidence defined in the packet.
original.evidence: Required-record column and source requirements.
original.grader_hint: Reconcile the event-to-record mapping with the controlled record list, including proof of dispatch, receipt, paint completion, and return.

criteria.description: 该序列通过预约、直接移交和释放控制，尊重整理单元的单停靠、无分段条件。
criteria.evidence: 流程顺序、时间控制和与码头相关的注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认设计不依赖于未建模的等待或暂存区域，并包括码头无法接受负载时所需的源响应。

original.criterion: The sequence respects the finishing cell’s one-dock, no-staging condition through appointment, direct handoff, and release controls.
original.evidence: Flow sequence, timing controls, and dock-related notes.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the design does not rely on an unmodeled waiting or staging area and includes the source-required response when the dock cannot accept a load.

criteria.description: 批次、数量或文档不匹配会将物料转至所提供的保留状态，并阻止正常消耗或接收，直至解决。
criteria.evidence: 异常分支、状态代码和发布控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪异常分支并验证事务处理和物理隔离或不使用控制。

original.criterion: A lot, quantity, or documentation mismatch routes material to the supplied hold status and prevents normal consumption or receipt until resolution.
original.evidence: Exception branch, status code, and release control.
original.grader_hint: Trace the exception branch and verify both the transaction treatment and the physical segregation or non-use control.

criteria.description: 不合格输出过程包括识别、控制、处置权限以及与所提供的政策一致的保留证据。
criteria.evidence: 不合格控制和记录字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据数据包中的质量要求独立检查所有四个功能。

original.criterion: The nonconforming-output process includes identification, control, disposition authority, and retained evidence consistent with the supplied policy.
original.evidence: Nonconformance controls and record fields.
original.grader_hint: Check all four functions independently against the quality requirements in the packet.

criteria.description: 该模型将其可追溯性、保存、记录信息和不合格控制与数据包中标识的适用 ISO 9001:2015 条款连接起来。
criteria.evidence: 条款引用和相关控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认每个引用的条款都与相关的操作控制配对，而不是在没有应用的情况下列出。

original.criterion: The model connects its traceability, preservation, documented-information, and nonconformance controls to the applicable ISO 9001:2015 clauses identified in the packet.
original.evidence: Clause references and associated controls.
original.grader_hint: Confirm each cited clause is paired with the relevant operational control rather than listed without application.

criteria.description: 该模型陈述并正确应用截至 15 一月 2025 提供的俄亥俄州要求，包括其适用范围。
criteria.evidence: 管辖权说明、流量控制和日期参考。
criteria.grader_hint: 将应用程序与数据包的俄亥俄州部分进行比较，并确保模型不会将条件要求扩大到超出其规定的范围。

original.criterion: The model states and correctly applies the supplied Ohio requirements as of 15 January 2025, including their applicability boundaries.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction note, flow controls, and date reference.
original.grader_hint: Compare the application with the packet’s Ohio section and ensure the model does not broaden a conditional requirement beyond its stated scope.

criteria.description: 该模型以与来源一致的方式明确解决了“站点”的不同业务和 ERP 含义，并防止读者将物理托管与 ERP 配置混淆。
criteria.evidence: 整个工作簿中使用的解释说明和术语。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断所规定的约定是否消除了歧义，然后在选项、流程和推荐语言中一致使用。

original.criterion: The model explicitly resolves the differing business and ERP meanings of “site” in a way that is consistent with the sources and prevents readers from confusing physical custody with ERP configuration.
original.evidence: Interpretation note and terminology used across the workbook.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the stated convention closes the ambiguity and is then used consistently in option, flow, and recommendation language.

criteria.description: 决策关键给出了搁置每个不推荐的替代方案的来源支持的理由，与其实际的门、分数、成本或操作结果相关。
criteria.evidence: 替代理由和评估结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据该选项的计算证据检查每个理由；诸如“风险太大”之类的一般性陈述是不够的。

original.criterion: The decision key gives a source-supported reason for setting aside each nonrecommended alternative, tied to its actual gate, score, cost, or operational consequence.
original.evidence: Alternative rationales and assessment results.
original.grader_hint: Check each rationale against that option’s calculated evidence; generic statements such as “too risky” are insufficient.

criteria.description: 关键评估中的每个标准评级都有一个基本原理，可以从工作簿引用的源事实中得到解释，并与指定的评级一致。
criteria.evidence: 评级理由、来源参考和分数。
criteria.grader_hint: 对所有选项-标准组合进行抽样或系统检查；理由必须支持所提供评分指南下的实际评分。

spec.professional_context: Fallowbrook Industries must establish a controlled material and records flow between its fabrication plant and a remote leased paint cell before March operations begin. The design affects transport cost, ERP scope, customer lot traceability, quality compliance, and the safe use of a single-dock facility with no staging.
difficulty_sources: Completing a reusable formula-driven workbook without blurring editable assumptions and protected outputs
Applying a deterministic feasibility and weighted-scoring policy to three operationally plausible designs
Maintaining customer lot identity across physical movement, ERP transactions, custody changes, and exception handling
Reconciling the physical and ERP meanings of site and documenting the chosen convention
Keeping a non-specialist PDF exactly aligned with the workbook's calculated figures and recommendation

authoring_plan.intended_verdict: The controlled scoring and feasibility policy selects the remote-location design operating within the existing single-site ERP configuration. The true second-site configuration is ineligible for launch because the required licence and implementation readiness are unavailable by the policy date, while the outside-processing design remains technically possible but ranks lower under the supplied traceability, transaction-control, and cost rules.

template_workbook.purpose: Provide the local field names, tables, style legend, validations, named ranges, protection intent, period-comparison area, assessment matrix, flow-control fields, and keyed-decision area. Leave controlled source values, formulas, ratings, rationales, flow rows, and decision results incomplete for the solver.

required_conventions.editable_inputs: A distinct visible input style and unlocked-cell convention identified in the legend.
required_conventions.computed_outputs: A different visible result style, locked-cell convention, and formula expectation identified in the legend.
option_vocabulary: Remote warehouse within current ERP site

template_workbook.keyed_requirements: The completed Decision Key must contain a formula-derived recommendation, the three-option scoring guide, criterion-level rationales, rejection reasons for both nonselected alternatives, and the site-terminology interpretation. Every rating must be answerable from the source facts and its rationale.

requirements_packet.purpose: Provide complete, mutually consistent controlled facts and deterministic policy without requiring internet access.
content_requirements: Define a current-state period and a launch-state period, including dates, demand, shipment units, frequency basis, and any volume conversion needed by the model.
Provide one-way distance, round-trip basis, usable vehicle capacity, fixed and variable loop-cost components, and any driver or handling component used in the transport calculation.
State that the remote finishing cell has one dock, no staging area, appointment-controlled delivery, and a defined unable-to-accept response.
Describe actual ERP behavior under the current single-site licence and the additional licensing and readiness condition for a genuine second ERP site.
Define the three permissible alternatives and enough facts to rate each under every decision criterion.
Provide criteria, weights totaling 100%, deterministic rating thresholds, mandatory gates, and an explicit tie-break rule.
Set quantitative material-change thresholds for the period comparison.
Define the complete transaction sequence and the permitted purpose of each local transaction code.
Require preservation of the customer lot identity through paint, with any container or paint-batch identifier linked rather than substituted.
Define custody, record ownership, required evidence, mismatch handling, quarantine status, release authority, and nonconforming-output records.
Summarize the applicable ISO 9001:2015 controls for documented information, identification and traceability, preservation, and control of nonconforming outputs.
Summarize the applicable Ohio transport, record, and load-control requirements as of 15 January 2025, including explicit applicability boundaries.

Explain that the business uses site for a physical operating location while the ERP uses site for a licensed configuration object, leaving the solver to state and consistently apply a terminology convention.

graded_structure.guidance: A concise Read Me must identify editable cells, calculated cells, validation use, warning interpretation, recalculation, and publication checks. It must remain subordinate to the operating model.
graded_structure.input_output_separation: Editable assumptions are visibly distinct and unlocked. Calculations, feasibility, scores, ranks, recommendation, and keyed rationales are visibly distinct, formula-driven where applicable, locked, and protected.
graded_structure.period_model: Model the two source-defined periods, whole-load loop calculation, transport cost, absolute and percentage changes, and material-change flags.
graded_structure.option_model: Represent exactly the three supplied alternatives, criteria and weights, deterministic ratings, weighted results, mandatory feasibility gates, tie-breaking, rank, and formula-derived recommendation.
graded_structure.flow_model: Represent every physical and record event from outbound release through final receipt, plus the mismatch/nonconformance branch. Each event carries direction, transaction code, custody, control owner, lot treatment, required record, and control.
graded_structure.decision_key: Carry the model's own answer key: recommendation, score interpretation, criterion rationales, rejection reasons, compliance basis, and terminology convention.
graded_structure.physical_use: The workbook is updated electronically and may be printed for an ERP scoping meeting. Substantive sheets are landscape, fit to one page wide, and repeat table headers when needed. The PDF is a self-contained one-to-three-page handout for non-specialists.

gold_relationships: Truck loops for a period equal the source-defined shipment demand divided by usable vehicle capacity, rounded upward to a whole loop.
Period transport cost equals calculated loops multiplied by the complete source-defined per-loop cost basis.
Absolute change equals launch result minus current result; percentage change uses the template's current-period denominator convention.
A material-change flag is true exactly when the applicable source threshold is met or exceeded.
Each weighted criterion result equals the alternative rating multiplied by the criterion weight under the scale convention supplied in the packet.
Each option total equals the sum of its weighted criterion results.
An alternative is eligible only when every mandatory gate is satisfied.
Recommendation selects the highest-scoring eligible alternative and applies the supplied tie-break rule only when eligible totals are equal.
The remote-location design wins under the supplied facts and policy; changing an unlocked assumption must allow formulas to change period results, option outcomes, or recommendation as applicable.
Customer lot identity remains unchanged across all ordinary movement and processing events.
Any mismatch or nonconformance routes to QHOLD and blocks ordinary consumption or final receipt until authorized disposition.
Every figure or decision statement shared with the PDF equals the corresponding calculated or keyed workbook result.
imperfections_to_include: The workbook is only partially completed: structural affordances exist, but source inputs, formulas, scoring, flow events, rationales, and the decision key require completion.
The two sources use the word site in different legitimate senses. The source packet explains both senses but does not prescribe the exact wording of the solver's convention.
All operational facts are internally consistent; difficulty comes from correctly operating the supplied deterministic policy and preserving the model's reusable internal structure.
The source material contains three workable designs with different disadvantages, but the controlled launch-readiness gate and weighted policy produce one bounded recommendation.

deliverables.description: Completed, reusable interplant flow and transaction model with editable assumptions, live calculations, option scoring, transaction controls, and an internally consistent decision key.
constraints: Retain the template’s required field and sheet conventions; distinguish editable inputs from computed outputs; use live formulas where calculations are required; contain no external links or macros; and remain operable in a standard spreadsheet application.

deliverables.description: Plain-language decision brief summarizing the period comparison, recommended interplant design, alternatives, transaction flow, costs, quality controls, and governing requirements.
constraints: No more than three pages; suitable for a broad non-specialist audience; and fully consistent with the completed workbook.

original_instruction:
You are Viktor Hartnett, the shipping and inventory clerk supporting Fallowbrook Industries’ fabrication operation in Ohio. Starting in March, painted assemblies will move through a leased finishing cell 40 miles from the main plant, and Priya Nightingale needs a defensible interplant material and transaction design before the ERP work is scoped. The current ERP licence covers one site, the customer requires unbroken lot traceability through painting, each truck loop has a meaningful cost, and the finishing cell has one dock with no staging space. Use the partially completed `Fallowbrook_interplant_design_template.xlsx` together with the operating, ERP, quality, and Ohio requirements in `Saltcombe_flow_requirements_2025-01-15.pdf`. Complete a reusable analytical model that compares the current and launch periods, evaluates all three alternatives identified in the source material, recommends one design under the stated policy, and records why the other two were set aside. The model must show the physical movements, ERP transactions, custody and records at each handoff, lot-trace controls, and the response to a mismatch or nonconforming lot. Keep user-editable assumptions clearly separate from calculated results, retain the template’s field names and conventions, and include brief guidance so another clerk can update the model without obscuring the decision itself. Priya also needs a plain-language decision brief suitable for readers who do not work in shipping or ERP; keep that PDF to no more than three pages and make the important period changes, recommendation, alternatives, costs, constraints, and controls understandable without opening the workbook. Apply the ISO 9001 and Ohio requirements supplied in the packet as of 15 January 2025, and identify any interpretation you had to make where the business and ERP use the word “site” differently. Write the completed files into the top level of your working directory using exactly `Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx` and `Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf`; the recommendation and every figure shared by the two files must agree.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Fallowbrook_interplant_design_template.xlsx` — Partially completed analytical-model template carrying the required sheet names, field labels, option and criterion vocabulary, input/output conventions, validation choices, and decision-key structure.
- `references/Saltcombe_flow_requirements_2025-01-15.pdf` — Controlled source for the two comparison periods, operating assumptions, three permissible designs, ERP behavior, transaction codes, decision policy, costs, lot-trace requirements, ISO 9001 controls, and applicable Ohio requirements as of 15 January 2025.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Fallowbrook_interplant_flow_model.xlsx` — Completed, reusable interplant flow and transaction model with editable assumptions, live calculations, option scoring, transaction controls, and an internally consistent decision key. (Retain the template’s required field and sheet conventions; distinguish editable inputs from computed outputs; use live formulas where calculations are required; contain no external links or macros; and remain operable in a standard spreadsheet application.)
- `Fallowbrook_interplant_decision_brief.pdf` — Plain-language decision brief summarizing the period comparison, recommended interplant design, alternatives, transaction flow, costs, quality controls, and governing requirements. (No more than three pages; suitable for a broad non-specialist audience; and fully consistent with the completed workbook.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
